title: Enhancing HPX with FleCSI: Automatic Detection of Implicit Task Dependencies
problem: Mapping Legion-like task graph programming model to HPX's different programming semantics is challenging; balancing parallelism opportunities vs overhead
motivation: FleCSI enables performance-portable code; HPX backend provides middle ground between MPI's low overhead and Legion's parallelism; efficient mapping enables better performance
method: Design and implement HPX backend for FleCSI; map task dependencies to HPX futures; optimize inter-task communicator creation to minimize costly operations; empirical evaluation on two physics applications
key_novelty: Novel optimization for minimizing HPX communicator creation overhead; efficient mapping of Legion-like DAG semantics to HPX futures
contributions: Mapping of task graph to HPX futures with optimizations
Performance evaluation demonstrating benefit of optimizations
baselines: MPI and Legion backends for FleCSI
limitations: Evaluation on only two applications; generalization to diverse applications not established
primary_theme: Efficient runtime mapping of task-parallel programming models
